adjudication.rationale: The diff removes support for passing usernames during group creation: the client model `Discourse.Group#create()` now POSTs only `asJSON()` (name/alias_level/visible) and `Admin::GroupsController#create` now reads top-level `params[:name]` / `params[:visible]` with no `usernames` handling. Membership is now managed via separate endpoints (`add_members` / `remove_member`) and UI action `addMembers`. While there are controller specs for `create` and for `add_members` separately, there is no test that exercises the combined create-then-add-members flow (e.g., create via controller then add_members using the returned id), and no integration/client-level test coverage is shown for this new workflow.
